leads.name: WorldMemBench (Zhejiang University / Ant Group, arXiv 2610.19063)
leads.why: Below the salience bar as of 2026-10-18: published 2026-10-13, no uptake yet (15 GitHub stars), and its static/dynamic revisit tests overlap MBench and WorldRoamBench.

leads.name: R2M-Bench: relative revisit memory for interactive video world models (arXiv 2608.27328)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: no recorded uptake, and its revisit-memory scoring overlaps WorldRoamBench from the same Amap group and MBench.

leads.name: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity (arXiv 2608.02603)
leads.why: Below the salience bar as of 2026-10-18: no recorded uptake (22 GitHub stars) and it overlaps WRBench, WBench and iWorld-Bench, already in the gallery; its 'world reactivity' level is the notable idea.

leads.name: OPIS: An Input-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Object Memory in Video World Models (arXiv 2609.35052)
leads.why: No project page, code or video as of 2026-10-18, and its object-memory tests overlap MBench and WorldMemBench.

leads.name: WorldMemBench (arXiv 2610.19063) and R2M-Bench (arXiv 2608.27328)
leads.why: Both benchmarks closed individually in infra-2026-10d as below the salience bar (overlap MBench and WorldRoamBench).

leads.name: Sekai2 dataset (Alaya Lab, arXiv 2608.09449)
leads.why: Below the salience bar: a two-month-old exploration-video dataset (2,826 h, 74 GitHub stars) without recorded uptake; Alaya Lab is represented by AlayaWorld and Alaya-EVOKE.

leads.name: HelixBench (Noiz AI, 2026-10-12)
leads.why: Covered by noiz-ai--helixworld, which presents HelixBench as part of the HelixWorld release.
